Films from BibleProject

In The Journey with Luke some of the cards in the witness book point to short animated films about what the day is about. Here are all the films, day by day. This page is free and open for everyone, including those who have not bought the full journey.

The films are made by and belong to BibleProject (bibleproject.com), and they play on BibleProject’s own website. We only link to them. BibleProject has not made or approved the game.

The links leave the game and go to bibleproject.com. BibleProject’s own terms and privacy policy apply there. You may want to watch the film first yourself, or together with the child.

Door 2: The priest in the temple

  • Gospel of Luke, Part 1 (Luke 1–9)
    An overview of the first half of Luke’s Gospel: who Luke wrote for, and how Jesus turns upside down who is counted as important. In the game: «The Gospels as lives».

Door 3: The priest who fell silent

  • John the Baptist
    John the Baptist, who called people to turn back and baptised them in the Jordan before Jesus stepped forward. In the game: «Zechariah’s song and the hope of Israel».

Door 4: A town nobody reckoned with

  • The Birth of Jesus (Luke 1–2)
    The birth of Jesus: a poor family, shepherds in the fields, and a king who comes in a wholly unexpected way. In the game: «Told the Jewish way».
